messages:
clare_docs: Heads-up: I'm assembling a short, copy-paste friendly migration playbook for v1 -> v2 (api + sdk + embed swap). Looking for owners for tiny snippets, banner copy, a reindex note, and QA checks.

josh_sdk: I can own JS + Python snippets and a 1-line SDK changelog blurb. Will use `model_id` in examples and show one old->new line.

rita_prod: Hosted flip is scheduled for 2024-11-18 16:00 UTC. Dedicated customers will have a 14-day opt-in. Docs must list dates, how to opt in, and that streaming fallback is not automatic.

omar_infra: Confirm: infra won't auto-convert streaming semantics. We'll publish a minimal compat translator for sync calls only (3 lines). I'll provide it with a WARNING.

nina_qa: Tag me on the PR. I'll run smoke: generation, streaming client, embeddings, and a reindex run for pgvector. I'll paste a small reindex pseudo-cmd to include.

clare_docs: Proposed contents and owners:
- banner copy (soft + firm) 	7: clare_docs (draft)
- snippets (JS/Py) and changelog line: josh_sdk (EOD tomorrow)
- compat helper + infra note: omar_infra (Mon)
- QA smoke plan + reindex example: nina_qa (Mon)
- assemble guide + open PR: clare_docs (Tue AM)

josh_sdk: Draft SDK blurb: "Breaking: `model` renamed to `model_id`; streaming validation tightened. Update callsites and re-run streaming tests." Example: `// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hi' })
// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hi' })`

omar_infra: Compat helper (py): `if 'model' in req: req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')  # WARNING: only for simple sync calls; streaming frames differ`

nina_qa: Reindex pseudo-cmd: `python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src legacy_idx --dst v2_idx --model redwood/v2-embed-xl` + note to alter pgvector dim before ingest.

clare_docs: Banner suggestions:
- soft: "Notice: v1 endpoints are scheduled for deprecation. See migration guide."
- firm: "Deprecated: v1 endpoints retire on 2025-02-01. Please migrate to v2." Use soft on doc pages; firm for timeline/announcements.

josh_sdk: I'll produce tiny copy examples for JS/Py and add short note in the SDK changelog.

omar_infra: When PR lands we'll run a docs canary and smoke tests; if snippets fail we'll block merge.

ci-bot: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/compact-v1v2` will run lint + smoke at 2024-11-06T09:30:00Z.

clare_docs: Thanks all 	7 I'll open the draft PR with owners listed and ping #docs-review. Target to land draft Tue AM so we have a few days before the hosted flip.
